profile: stugx.CASL independently authored classroom demo corpus v1
copyrightPolicy: Short original programs written for regression and teaching; no textbook or slide images are included.

programs.title: Load and store one word
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#0061
     ST GR1,DATA
     LD GR2,DATA
     RET
DATA DS 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: ST changes Memory without clearing the source register; LD reads the stored word.

programs.title: Arithmetic overflow and FR
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#7FFF
     ADDA GR1,ONE
     RET
ONE  DC 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: A signed overflow sets OF while the 16-bit result sets SF and ZF.

programs.title: Compare and branch
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,3
     CPA GR1,THREE
     JZE MATCH
     LAD GR2,0
     RET
MATCH LAD GR2,1
     RET
THREE DC 3
     END
programs.teachingPoint: CPA updates OF/SF/ZF and JZE reads ZF without changing it.

programs.title: Three-iteration loop
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,0
     LAD GR2,3
LOOP ADDA GR1,ONE
     SUBA GR2,ONE
     JNZ LOOP
     RET
ONE  DC 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: The loop counter reaches zero and JNZ stops taking the branch.

programs.title: Stack round trip
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#1234
     PUSH 0,GR1
     LAD GR1,0
     POP GR2
     RET
     END
programs.teachingPoint: PUSH and POP transfer one 16-bit word through Memory while SP returns to its initial value.

programs.title: Subroutine call and return
programs.source:
MAIN START
     CALL SUB
     LAD GR2,1
     RET
SUB  LAD GR1,#0042
     RET
     END
programs.teachingPoint: CALL stores the return address on the COMET II stack and RET restores PR.

programs.title: Input and output record
programs.source:
MAIN START
     IN BUF,LEN
     OUT BUF,LEN
     RET
BUF  DS 256
LEN  DS 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: IN waits without blocking the browser, then OUT emits the submitted record as plain text.

programs.title: Register save and restore
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#1111
     RPUSH
     LAD GR1,#2222
     RPOP
     RET
     END
programs.teachingPoint: RPUSH and RPOP expand to real PUSH/POP instructions for GR1 through GR7; GR0 is not included.

programs.title: Character string storage
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LD GR1,TEXT
     LAD GR2,1
     LD GR3,TEXT,GR2
     RET
TEXT DC 'ABC'
     END
programs.teachingPoint: DC stores one character per consecutive word and adds no implicit terminator.

programs.title: Indexed load and store
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,DATA
     LD GR2,1,GR1
     LAD GR3,DST
     ST GR2,0,GR3
     RET
DATA DC 10,20
DST  DS 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: The effective address is the address operand plus the selected GR1-GR7 index value.

programs.title: AND OR XOR
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#00F0
     AND GR1,MASK
     OR GR1,ADDEND
     XOR GR1,TOGGLE
     RET
MASK DC #00FF
ADDEND DC #0F00
TOGGLE DC #00FF
     END
programs.teachingPoint: Each logical instruction operates on the same 16-bit word and updates FR using the official rule.

programs.title: Logical shift and OF
programs.source:
MAIN START
     LAD GR1,#8001
     SLL GR1,1
     RET
     END
programs.teachingPoint: The last bit shifted out is written to OF; COMET II exposes no CF.

programs.title: PRG0204-style reverse copy
programs.source:
PRG0204 START
     LAD GR1,ORG
     LAD GR2,DST
     LD GR3,3,GR1
     LD GR4,2,GR1
     LD GR5,1,GR1
     LD GR6,0,GR1
     ST GR3,0,GR2
     ST GR4,1,GR2
     ST GR5,2,GR2
     ST GR6,3,GR2
     RET
ORG  DC '0123'
DST  DS 4
     END
programs.teachingPoint: Four indexed reads and writes reverse the independently authored digit sequence into DST.

programs.title: PRG0205-style record echo
programs.source:
PRG0205 START
     IN BUF,LEN
     OUT BUF,LEN
     RET
BUF  DS 256
LEN  DS 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: The input length and output record can be observed without a synchronous browser prompt.

programs.title: Two-module CALL

modules.source:
MAIN START
     CALL SUB
     RET
     END

SUB  START
     LAD GR1,#0042
     RET
     END

programs.teachingPoint: Independent module assembly and a call-target relocation produce one linked image without concatenating source.

programs.title: LD microcycle observation
programs.source:
MICRO START
     LD GR2,DATA
     RET
DATA DC #0061
     END
programs.teachingPoint: Fetch, Decode, Effective Address, Operand Read, Write Back, Flag Update, and Complete are real runtime transitions.

programs.title: Reverse one committed microcycle
programs.source:
REVMIC START
     LAD GR1,#0061
     ST GR1,DATA
     RET
DATA DS 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: After observing a write phase, Reverse Microstep restores the retained pre-phase runtime transaction.

programs.title: Reverse one machine instruction
programs.source:
REVINS START
     LAD GR1,1
     ADDA GR1,ONE
     RET
ONE  DC 1
     END
programs.teachingPoint: Reverse Instruction groups the retained microcycles and returns atomically to the state before Fetch.
